get.summary: Get vessel calls information from external API

parameters.name: vesselImo
parameters.description: The IMO number of the vessel e.g. 9515802,9410026,8210699,5355632

parameters.name: vesselName
parameters.description: Current name of the vessel. Additional functionality available, see 'Standard Functionality'. e.g. Queen Mary 2

parameters.name: vesselMmsi
parameters.description: MMSI number currently used by the vessel. e.g. 310627000

parameters.name: classb
parameters.description: If supplied as ‘true’, known class B vessels will be included in the API response.

parameters.name: dateRange
parameters.description: If no dateRange supplied the API will return the previous 7 days history. Maximum dateRange allowed is 6 months. e.g. 2020-12-01 – 2020-12-31

parameters.name: includeBerths
parameters.description: If supplied as ‘true’ will include details of berth callings within the port (requires additional subscription).

get.summary: Advanced Compliance risk ratings for one or more vessels, including risks flagged and their details across AIS Gaps, Loitering, AIS Manipulation, Flag, Ownership, Ship to Ship Transfer and movements (available by supplying either VesselId, VesselImo, VesselName, vesselMmsi)

parameters.name: vesselImo
parameters.description: The IMO number of the vessel e.g. 9515802,9410026,8210699,5355632

parameters.name: vesselName
parameters.description: Current name of the vessel. Additional functionality available, see 'Standard Functionality'. e.g. Queen Mary 2

parameters.name: vesselMmsi
parameters.description: MMSI number currently used by the vessel. e.g. 310627000

parameters.name: riskType
parameters.description: Type of individual compliance risk that API endpoint output should fetch. For allowed values see below. Default All. e.g. flag,sts

parameters.name: vesselComplianceRiskScore
parameters.description: Filter results by overall vessel compliance risk score. For allowed values see below. e.g. High,Medium

parameters.name: vesselAisGapRating
parameters.description: Filter results by AIS gap risk rating. For allowed values see below. e.g. High
